messages:
Riley (Billing): Heads-up  Solaris.ai invoiced twice for onboarding credit: looks like promo ONBOARD-50 applied and marketing-issued manual credit both hit invoice 12207 resulting in net zero then negative balance. Need to reverse the marketing manual credit and keep promo.
Noah (Account Manager): Customer called — they only expected the automated 50% promo, not the extra manual credit. They want corrected invoice and a short note explaining what happened.
Riley (Billing): Invoice lines: ```
Invoice: 12207
Customer: Solaris.ai (US)
Charges: Service usage $4,800.00
Promo ONBOARD-50: -$2,400.00
Manual credit (marketing-override): -$2,400.00
Total: $0.00 (system shows negative balance after refund processing)
```
Riley (Billing): The manual credit came from ticket MG-3399 where marketing asked CS to apply a "welcome" credit. It should have been blocked by promo rules.
Priya (Head of Billing): We should reverse the manual credit and issue a corrected invoice. Any tax consequences? tax-bot?
tax-bot: For US B2B SaaS, credit reversals that reduce previously recorded credits are revenue-positive adjustments. No sales tax in this state (MA). Ensure GL reversals: credit accounts_receivable and debit revenue accordingly.
Noah (Account Manager): Customer is fine with correction. I'll add a sentence offering a $50 account credit as apology; will that need approval?
Priya (Head of Billing): Approve up to $100 goodwill without exec sign-off. Keep the apology credit separate as a small CM. Riley, draft CM to reverse the marketing manual credit (amount $2,400) and another small CM for $50 goodwill.
Riley (Billing): billing-bot, create CM-2026-799 reverse amount $2,400 reason="duplicate manual credit - marketing override" and CM-2026-800 goodwill $50 reason="apology credit". Attach ticket MG-3399.
billing-bot: CM-2026-799 created (DRAFT) for $2,400.00; CM-2026-800 created (DRAFT) for $50.00. Attachments: MG-3399.pdf.
Priya (Head of Billing): Move CM-2026-799 to PENDING_APPROVAL (approver: Priya) and CM-2026-800 auto-approve (within goodwill threshold).
billing-bot: CM-2026-800 moved to APPROVED and applied as account credit. CM-2026-799 status -> PENDING_APPROVAL (approver: Priya).
Priya (Head of Billing): Approved CM-2026-799. Add memo: "Approved reversal of marketing manual credit; promo ONBOARD-50 remains applied per promo policy v2."
Riley (Billing): billing-bot, finalize and apply CM-2026-799 to Invoice 12207 and post GL entries.
billing-bot: CM-2026-799 moved to APPROVED and applied to Invoice 12207. New invoice balance: $2,400.00 (due). Journal: CRD-2026-799 posted; RevOps notified for revenue recognition impact.
Noah (Account Manager): Notified customer with the following note: "We found a duplicate credit applied to your invoice by mistake. We've reversed the extra credit and issued an apology credit of $50 to your account. Your corrected invoice shows a balance of $2,400. Please reach out if you have questions." Customer replied: "Thanks for fixing this quickly  we appreciate the $50." :thumbsup:
Riley (Billing): Closing thread and attaching CM paperwork to June month-end bundle. Also creating ticket MG-3399 follow-up for marketing to block manual credits when promo ONBOARD-50 exists.
